title: Tarbell Fellowship
about: Twelve-month fellowship for journalists covering artificial intelligence, with newsroom placements from September 2027 to May 2028. Applications for the 2027-28 cohort close 22 November 2026; second-stage decisions by end of December and fellows selected in March 2027.
requirements: At least 18 years old by the fellowship start date, June 7, 2027
At least one writing sample must be in prose format (e.g. news article, blog post or essay)

upskill.name: Generative AI Academy
why: "AI journalism" / skill "Artificial intelligence" → Generative AI Academy course A002.17 objective "Misinformation, deepfakes, and synthetic media detection" (course not in the scored shortlist, so the Academy page is used)
"Journalists (early to mid career)" covering AI → A002.17 objective "Hallucination: factuality and faithfulness failures; taxonomy and mitigation"

Shortlisted courses (e.g. A003.02 Writing Effective Prompts) matched only on terms like "writ"/"format"; their objectives cover prompting AI systems, not journalistic writing, so none was a genuine match
